changes_vs_current: New topic; all 50 states were candidates (DC excluded as not a state). Ranked by average position across 7 people sources (missing = list length + 5). Raw average order: 1 Hawaii 1.71, 2 Florida 4.0, 3 California 4.21, 4 New York 5.5, 5 Texas 5.86, 6 Colorado 7.5, 7 Alaska 9.07, 8 North Carolina 9.14, 9 Arizona 12.0, 10 Washington 12.14, 11 Tennessee 12.29, 12 Virginia 12.43, 13 Georgia 13.86, 14 Massachusetts 14.0, 15 Minnesota 14.29, 16 Oregon 14.71, 17 South Carolina 15.86, 18 Montana 16.0, 19 Maine 16.0, 20 Pennsylvania 16.14, 21 Wyoming 16.14, 22 Michigan 16.29, 23 New Mexico 17.86, 24 Ohio 18.0. Final list = raw order, no moves. Gut check: 10 of my 12 landed in the top 12. Oregon (raw 16) was kept: Harris 2013/2015 have it 9th, but YouGov 2025 very-favorable puts it 17th and pageviews 33rd. Montana (raw 18) was kept: YouGov 2025 has it 10th very-favorable (3rd net), but neither Harris top-15 lists it and pageviews put it 27th. Both are in the 24, so no move was needed. Arizona and Virginia came in ahead of my gut. Arizona is backed by Harris (7th/8th) and YouGov 2021 (7th). Virginia is backed by YouGov 2021 (3rd) and Harris 2013 (11th).
confidence: High for 1-8 (Hawaii, Florida, California, New York, Texas, Colorado, Alaska, North Carolina): every source agrees on this group, and each has 5-7 sources. The order inside it is medium, because Hawaii vs Florida vs California at #1 depends on the measure: Hawaii leads favorability and want-to-visit, while Florida/California lead the 'favorite visited' and 'want to live' questions. Medium for 9-17. Low for 18-24: averages are within about 2 points, and Ohio, New Mexico and Michigan rest mostly on pageviews. Near misses: Vermont 18.29, Illinois 18.29, Louisiana 18.57, Connecticut 18.86, Nevada 19.0 (YouGov 2021 4th; Las Vegas appeal), New Jersey 19.0, Utah, Idaho. Caveats: Harris and PPP data are old (2011-2015); I could not find a recent Harris state ranking. The full YouGov 2021 chart was an image, so only its top 10 was read. Rhode Island pageviews were not retrieved (rate limit). PPP 2011-12 net favorability (Hawaii 1st, California last) was read but not used: it is old and net-based. Ranker was not used.
